newsitem.title: GREECE: CONSERVATIVES "CIVIL WAR" DESTROYING PARTY - MANOS.
newsitem.headline: CONSERVATIVES "CIVIL WAR" DESTROYING PARTY - MANOS.

text.p: Former conservative national economy minister Stephanos Manos said the conservative party had been plagued by six years of "civil war" which had resulted in election losses.
"For the past six years, there has been a civil war being staged inside New Democracy and this has cost us two election defeats. It is time to look forward," he said.
Manos was referring to the vicious battle between former premier Constantine Mitsotakis and former Athens mayor Miltiades Evert, who led the conservatives to a national election defeat last Sunday.
Manos and Mitsotakis's daughter Dora have said they will stand for the leadership of the conservative New Democracy party following Evert's resignation.
Manos was stating publicly what political commentators have known for years: the Evert and Mitsotakis camps are tearing the main conservative party apart. --Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
